svg.title: Nineteen states ban ranked-choice voting as of November 2026, 17 of them in all elections, by Ballotpedia’s reading.
svg.desc: A tile map with one square per state. Nineteen states ban ranked-choice voting as of November 2026: 17 in all elections, from Florida in 2022 to Indiana in 2026, and Ohio and Tennessee in some elections. The other 31 states and DC have no state ban.
